title: Readiness sprint lighthouse and traffic simmer plan
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact, operational-ready sprintboard + KPI heatmap to run a staged feature activation with an emphasis on 'simmer' — controlled traffic increases with explicit deceleration conditions. Designed to be used by product-ops, SRE, and the on-call commander during the first 72 hours of rollout.

High-level goals:
- Validate end-to-end latency and cost assumptions for the new routing policy (tiered-model fallback).
- Keep error rate < 0.5% and 95th latency < 350ms for the first 24h at each traffic step.
- Provide clear slow-down / rollback triggers and owner actions.

Scope and constraints:
- Applies to Hosted API + Dedicated fallback path. Private deployments excluded (separate playbook).
- Traffic steps: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> full. Each step is a minimum 3h dwell unless a trigger requires extension.
- Resources: dedicated pool of 8 A100-equivalent GPUs for canary, autoscale allowed beyond baseline with finance alert at >$X/hr.

Sprint lanes (who does what during each step):
- Product-ops (Lead: Asha) - orchestrates step timing, updates scoreboard, communicates to stakeholders.
- SRE (Lead: Michael) - watches infra metrics, initiates capacity scale or rollback.
- ML Serving (Lead: Lena) - monitors model quality regressions, inference errors, KV-cache warmup.
- CS/Support (rotating) - triage any customer tickets from pilot customers; escalate to commander for P1s.

KPI heatmap (primary signals):
- Latency P95 (ms): green <300, yellow 300-400, red >400
- Error rate (5xx + inference errors): green <0.3%, yellow 0.3-1.0%, red >1.0%
- Cost per 1k tokens (USD): green < $0.40, yellow $0.40-0.75, red > $0.75
- Model quality (regression on eval set): green delta < 1.0%, yellow 1-3%, red >3%
- Throughput (req/s): sanity check vs expected QPS, green within ±15%, yellow ±15-30%, red >30% deviation

Deceleration / rollback triggers (automated + manual):
- Automatic throttle (immediate): sustained P95 > 420ms for 5m OR error rate >1% for 3m -> reduce traffic to previous stable step and notify commander.
- Soft pause (manual review): model-quality regression flagged by eval pipeline (delta >2%) or unexplained spike in token cost -> pause progression and run three checkpoint checks.
- Full rollback: repeated auto-throttle at the same step twice within 24h OR critical customer impact P1 -> rollback to baseline (0% for canary) and open a postmortem.

Runbook checklist (pre-launch, during, post):
- Pre-launch (24-72h):
  - Finish canary smoke tests (API contract, edge cases) - owner: ML Serving (Lena).
  - Confirm fallback routing works end-to-end (test traffic) - owner: SRE (Michael).
  - Budget guardrails set in Console (notify finance on threshold) - owner: Product-ops.
  - Ops war room calendar + pings configured for 72h - owner: Product-ops.
  - Notify early-adopter customers and set expectations - owner: CS.

- During launch (per step):
  - Start timer for minimum dwell. Record baseline metrics snapshot (t0).
  - Update shared scoreboard every 15m with P95, errors, cost and a short note.
  - If auto-throttle triggers, follow 'Immediate throttle' path and escalate.
  - If manual pause triggered, convene 15m triage (commander decision).

- Post-launch (0-7d):
  - Consolidate metric time series and annotate with actions taken.
  - Run targeted evals on a representative prompt set to check for regressions.
  - Cost reconciliation vs forecast and write a one-page readout for finance.
  - If any rollback occurred, start incident review and follow remediation plan.

Contingency play cards (short):
- Latency spike while autoscaling: temporarily shift traffic to Dedicated pool; disable batching heuristics incrementally; verify kernel selection logs.
- Model hallucination/regression: pin to previous model-version, increase sampling for evals, notify product managers and CS.
- Unexpected cost surge: enact budget armor (rate limit, restrict non-essential routes), notify finance and senior PMs.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm list of early-adopter customer IDs to whitelist for extended logging (Ask CS: Diego).
- Finalize finance threshold amount (pending finance review).
- Add automation: one-click rollback from Console (Lena to file GH issue).

Quick communication templates (copy into Slack):
- Step start: "[LAUNCH] Starting step 2 -> 2% traffic. Dwell window 3h. Leads: Asha (POps)/Michael (SRE)/Lena (ML). Watch P95 and errors."
- Auto-throttle alert: "[AUTO-THROTTLE] Traffic stepped back from X% -> Y% due to sustained P95 > 420ms. Commander: @Michael. Follow runbook."

Action items (short):
- [ ] Asha: finalize war room schedule and stakeholder list (due 2025-09-05).
- [ ] Michael: run failover drill for Dedicated routing (due 2025-09-06).
- [ ] Lena: add eval set checks to CI and baseline before launch (due 2025-09-04).
- [ ] Diego (CS): confirm early-adopter contact list (due 2025-09-03).

Notes (fast capture):
- This doc is intentionally terse — keep operational steps short to reduce cognitive load in war room.
- If something ambiguous appears in metrics, default to 'pause and investigate' rather than proceed.
- Keep the scoreboard visible on Console and mirror to the #launch-warroom channel.

End of doc.
